经过: 隋军讨高宝宁，宝宁奔契丹，为部下所杀。
text_en: Sui troops attack Gao Baoning, who flees to the Khitan and is killed by his own men.

经过: 隋征萧琮入朝，废后梁。
text_en: Sui summons Xiao Cong to court and abolishes the Later Liang.

经过: 隋军克建康，擒陈叔宝，陈亡。
text_en: Sui armies take Jiankang and capture Chen Shubao; Chen falls.

经过: 刘方讨交州，李佛子降。
text_en: Liu Fang marches on Jiaozhou and Lý Phật Tử surrenders.

经过: 李密为王世充所败于邙山，西降唐（年底叛唐被杀）。
text_en: Defeated by Wang Shichong at Mangshan, Li Mi goes west and submits to Tang (he rebels and is killed at the end of the year).

经过: 郭子和降唐。
text_en: Guo Zihe submits to Tang.

经过: 薛举病死，李世民破薛仁杲于浅水原，仁杲降。
text_en: Xue Ju dies of illness; Li Shimin defeats Xue Rengao at Qianshuiyuan and Rengao surrenders.

经过: 王世充废皇泰主，建国号郑，隋亡。
text_en: Wang Shichong deposes the Huangtai emperor and names his own dynasty Zheng; Sui falls.

经过: 安修仁等执李轨降唐。
title_en: Fall of Li Gui's Great Liang
text_en: An Xiuren and others seize Li Gui and surrender to Tang.

经过: 窦建德破聊城，斩宇文化及。
text_en: Dou Jiande takes Liaocheng and beheads Yuwen Huaji.

经过: 罗艺以幽州降唐。
text_en: Luo Yi submits to Tang with Youzhou.

经过: 李子通破沈法兴，法兴投水死。
text_en: Li Zitong defeats Shen Faxing, who drowns himself.

经过: 窦建德擒孟海公。
text_en: Dou Jiande captures Meng Haigong.

经过: 虎牢之战，窦建德被擒。
text_en: At the battle of Hulao Dou Jiande is captured.

经过: 王世充以洛阳降唐。
text_en: Wang Shichong surrenders Luoyang to Tang.

经过: 唐置南宁州总管府，招抚爨部；以爨弘达为昆州刺史。
text_en: Tang sets up the Nanning Area Command to win over the Cuan tribes and makes Cuan Hongda prefect of Kunzhou.

经过: 李孝恭、李靖围江陵，萧铣出降。
text_en: Li Xiaogong and Li Jing besiege Jiangling, and Xiao Xian comes out to surrender.

经过: 杜伏威擒李子通。
text_en: Du Fuwei captures Li Zitong.

经过: 汪华以歙州等六州降唐。
text_en: Wang Hua submits to Tang with She and five other prefectures.

经过: 洺水之战败，刘黑闼奔突厥；复起后 623 年正月败死。
text_en: Defeated at the Ming River, Liu Heita flees to the Turks; he rises again and is killed early in 623.

经过: 冯盎以岭南诸州降唐，以其地置高、罗、春、白等州。
text_en: Feng Ang submits to Tang with the prefectures of Lingnan, which are reorganised as Gao, Luo, Chun, Bai and other prefectures.

经过: 林士弘病死，其众溃散。
text_en: Lin Shihong dies of illness and his followers scatter.

经过: 高满政以马邑降唐，苑君璋奔突厥。
text_en: Gao Manzheng surrenders Mayi to Tang, and Yuan Junzhang flees to the Turks.

经过: 徐圆朗弃城出走，为野人所杀。
text_en: Xu Yuanlang abandons his city and is killed by villagers.

经过: 高开道为部将张金树所杀，降唐。
text_en: Gao Kaidao is killed by his officer Zhang Jinshu, who surrenders to Tang.

经过: 杜伏威入朝；辅公祏据丹阳称宋，624 年败死，江淮平。
text_en: Du Fuwei goes to the Tang court; Fu Gongshi seizes Danyang and proclaims Song, but is defeated and killed in 624, and the Yangzi–Huai region is pacified.

经过: 唐兵围朔方，梁洛仁杀梁师都降。
text_en: Tang troops besiege Shuofang; Liang Luoren kills Liang Shidu and surrenders.

经过: 李靖袭定襄、阴山，擒颉利可汗，东突厥亡。
text_en: Li Jing surprises Dingxiang and the Yin Mountains and captures Illig Qaghan; the Eastern Turkic Qaghanate falls.

经过: 侯君集平高昌，置西州。
text_en: Hou Junji conquers Gaochang, and Xizhou is set up.

经过: 松赞干布灭象雄（据敦煌吐蕃文书）。
text_en: Songtsen Gampo conquers Zhangzhung (according to the Dunhuang Tibetan documents).

经过: 唐与回纥击灭薛延陀。
text_en: Tang and the Uyghurs destroy the Xueyantuo.

经过: 白霫内属，以其地为寘颜州（别部置居延州）。
title_en: The Bai Xi submit to Tang
text_en: The Bai Xi submit, and their land becomes Tianyan prefecture (a separate branch becomes Juyan prefecture).

经过: 阿史那社尔破焉耆，斩阿那支（644 年郭孝恪曾一度破之）。
text_en: Ashina She'er takes Karasahr and beheads Anazhi (Guo Xiaoke had briefly taken it in 644).

经过: 阿史那社尔破龟兹，擒其王。
text_en: Ashina She'er conquers Kucha and captures its king.

经过: 于阗王伏阇信入朝。
text_en: Fudu Xin, king of Khotan, comes to the Tang court.

经过: 疏勒内属，归安西都护府。
text_en: Kashgar submits and is placed under the Anxi Protectorate.

经过: 契丹窟哥举部内属，置松漠都督府。
text_en: Kuge of the Khitan submits with his whole people, and the Songmo Area Command is set up.

经过: 奚可度者内属，置饶乐都督府。
text_en: Keduzhe of the Xi submits, and the Raole Area Command is set up.

经过: 大食东侵，伊嗣俟三世被杀，萨珊亡（子卑路斯奔唐）。
text_en: The Arab armies advance east and Yazdegerd III is killed; the Sasanian Empire falls (his son Peroz flees to Tang).

经过: 苏定方破沙钵罗可汗，西突厥亡。
text_en: Su Dingfang defeats Ashina Helu (Shaboluo Qaghan), and the Western Turkic Qaghanate falls.

经过: 唐于昭武诸国置康居等都督府。
title_en: The Sogdian states submit to Tang
text_en: Tang sets up Kangju and other area commands among the Sogdian states.

经过: 唐置休循州都督府。
text_en: Tang sets up the Xiuxun Area Command in Ferghana.

经过: 唐于吐火罗置月氏等十六都督府。
text_en: Tang sets up the Yuezhi and fifteen other area commands in Tokharistan.

经过: 吐蕃禄东赞破吐谷浑，诺曷钵奔凉州。
text_en: Gar Tongtsen of Tibet crushes the Tuyuhun, and Nuohebo flees to Liangzhou.

经过: 白江口之战，百济复国军败，扶余丰北走（百济已亡于 660）。
text_en: At the battle of Baekgang the Baekje restoration army is crushed and Buyeo Pung flees north (Baekje itself had fallen in 660).

经过: 李勣克平壤，高句丽亡。
text_en: Li Ji takes Pyongyang, and Goguryeo falls.
